description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers the named authoring ask, the inventory ask, the story-as-test ask, the MCP-channel question, and a DE phrasing. Should-not-trigger covers the near-misses this skill sits between: authoring the component itself (ui-component-architect), a full WCAG audit of a shipped page (accessibility-auditor), an E2E flow test, the package surface (js-library-packaging), and a visual-design question.
